request: Analyze GSE313585 for PMID 42051351 (Icariin improves metabolic response to exercise by promoting TFEB-dependent mitochondrial clearance and metabolic reprogramming in C57BL/6 mice and C2C12 myotubes.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq, Illumina NovaSeq 6000, 150 bp paired-end, Lianchuan Biotechnology; aligned to mouse GRCm39 (S2.8.p1)
final.samples: C2C12 mouse myotubes treated with 20 uM Icariin or vehicle for 24 h, n = 3 per group (S2.8.p1, S3.3.p1); no caffeine/exercise-mimetic stimulation is stated for the sequenced cells
final.exercise_factor_in_transcriptome: none: the in vivo exercise tests (S2.2) used mice that were not sequenced; the caffeine 'exercise-like stress' model (S2.4.p2) is not part of the RNA-seq description (S2.8.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of Icariin (20 uM, 24 h) versus vehicle on the C2C12 myotube transcriptome; a drug effect, not an exercise effect
planned_contrasts: Icariin vs vehicle in C2C12 myotubes (S3.3.p1; paper: 1919 DEGs, 1134 up / 785 down)
final.paper_results: 1919 DEGs (1134 up, 785 down) at |log2FC| > 1 and padj < 0.05 (S3.3.p1); GO up: regulation of mitophagy, mitochondrial degradation involved in mitophagy, oxidative phosphorylation, mitochondrial inner membrane; GSEA positive for mitophagy sets (S3.3.p2); qPCR Pink1, Parkin, Bnip3, Ulk1 up (S3.3.p3)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.8.p1 and S3.3.p1 define the only transcriptome: mouse C2C12 myotubes, Icariin 20 uM vs vehicle, n = 3/group, DESeq2, |log2FC| > 1 and adjusted p < 0.05. DA.p1 names GSE313585. The exercise experiments (S2.2, S3.1) are mouse physiology without sequencing, so the paper itself defines no exercise contrast in expression data.

checks.organism: GEO: Rattus norvegicus (taxid 10116); paper: mouse C2C12 aligned to GRCm39 -> mismatch
checks.cell_type: GEO: primary rat microvascular vascular smooth muscle cells; paper: C2C12 myotubes -> mismatch
checks.platform: GEO: GPL20084 Illumina NextSeq 500, BGI Dr. Tom pipeline, RSEM, GRCr8; paper: NovaSeq 6000 150 bp PE by Lianchuan, GRCm39 -> mismatch
checks.feature_ids: matrix rows are rat Ensembl IDs (ENSRNOG...) -> not mouse
checks.timing: GEO overall design: controls harvested 24 h, Icariin 48 h post-treatment (time aliased with treatment); paper: 24 h for both arms -> mismatch
checks.sample_count_and_groups: 6 samples, Control 3 / Icariin 3 -> matches the paper's n = 3 per group in count only
checks.exercise_arm: none in GEO (treatment: Control / treated with Icariin) and none in the paper's sequenced samples

ownership.reasoning: The series is linked to PMID 42051351, but every sample-level fact contradicts the paper's RNA-seq (S2.8.p1): the deposit is rat primary vascular smooth muscle cells on NextSeq 500 quantified against rat GRCr8 (ENSRNOG IDs), not mouse C2C12 myotubes on NovaSeq 6000 against GRCm39. Only the 3 vs 3 group size agrees. The deposited files therefore do not belong to the paper's samples, and any DEG count from them could not be compared with the paper's 1919. Independently of ownership, neither the deposit nor the paper's transcriptome contains an exercise arm (Icariin vs control only), so the requested exercise estimand is not identifiable and a correct re-deposit would not change that for the exercise question.

candidates.value: owned: true (accession and PMID link, 3 vs 3 Icariin/control)
candidates.reason_rejected: organism, cell type, platform, reference genome and harvest timing all contradict S2.8.p1; matrix features are rat Ensembl IDs

candidates.value: manual_review (ask authors for the C2C12 data)
candidates.reason_rejected: even the paper's own C2C12 RNA-seq is Icariin vs vehicle with no exercise or exercise-mimetic arm, so no obtainable file would identify an exercise effect on expression

ownership.stop_reason: GSE313585 does not hold the paper's samples (rat primary vascular smooth muscle cells, NextSeq 500, rat Ensembl IDs vs the paper's mouse C2C12 myotubes, NovaSeq 6000, GRCm39), and neither the deposit nor the paper's transcriptome has an exercise contrast (Icariin vs control only). The exercise estimand cannot be identified.

discrepancies.data: primary rat microvascular vascular smooth muscle cells

discrepancies.paper: Illumina NovaSeq 6000, 150 bp PE, Lianchuan S2.8.p1

discrepancies.data: control 24 h, Icariin 48 h (GEO overall design): time aliased with treatment

discrepancies.paper: no exercise factor in the sequenced samples (S2.8.p1); exercise only in unsequenced mice (S2.2)
